title: Figma plan access token: the token id, the 24-hour refresh window and the category grammar
summary: A plan access token's id shown beside its secret, the two secret values valid during the 24 hours after a refresh, and the REST API, npm registry and Figma CLI categories of one token kind.
rationale: The X-Figma-Token header carrier of a plan access token is documented and is already the subject of the existing X-Figma-Token header Case; this record covers what that Case does not settle. Claim plan-token-secret-shown-once-id-viewable records that the secret is shown once and the id can be viewed and copied later, and that the page does not say whether the id may be disclosed (benign sibling figma-plan-access-token-id, class unresolved). Claim plan-token-refresh-previous-secret-valid-24h records that two secret values are valid for one token during the window, but names no carrier on which the new secret is displayed. Whether the three categories share one grammar (plan-token-categories-share-one-grammar) and how the npm registry category is sent (npm-registry-category-carrier-unstated) are not stated, and no prefix or length is stated (plan-token-lexical-shape-unstated); the figd_ prefix of the personal token is not extended. Contract claims cited: plan-access-token/plan-token-secret-shown-once-id-viewable, plan-access-token/plan-token-refresh-previous-secret-valid-24h, plan-access-token/x-figma-token-header-shared-with-personal-token.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted for these three properties. Settled by: a Figma statement of whether the token id may be disclosed, of the display of a refreshed secret and of the categories' grammar.

sources.supports: You can also view and copy the id of your plan access token. However, you can't access the token secret again. The secret is only visible when you first create the plan access token.
The new token secret is generated and available to copy. The previous secret continues to work for 24 hours. ... This applies to REST API, npm registry, and Figma CLI tokens.
The plan access token is immediately revoked. This action cannot be undone.
You can do so by passing the token to the API in the X-Figma-Token header of your request.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. No expectation is asserted and no value was built: the record states what the cited contract settles and what it leaves open. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
